en: Black‑and‑white historic view of a large cobblestoned town square lined with multi‑storey townhouses with arcades on the left and ornate façades on the right. Dominating the background is a large Baroque church with twin onion‑domed towers and a tall nave roof. In the right foreground stands an elaborate Baroque column or fountain with multiple statues. People in early‑20th‑century clothing stroll across the square and a child rides a bicycle. The image has speckling and wear consistent with an old photographic postcard. No legible caption is visible.
